name: xAI: Grok 4.5
description: Grok 4.5 is xAI's flagship model — its smartest to date, with frontier performance across coding, knowledge work, and STEM. Built on the 1.5-trillion-parameter V9 foundation and trained alongside the Cursor coding editor, it serves a 500K-token context window and accepts text, image, and file inputs with text output. It emphasizes strong agentic coding with notable token efficiency — resolving software-engineering tasks in far fewer output tokens than comparable frontier models — and is priced aggressively for high-volume production use.
